tracker-control-android.description:
TrackerControl is a free, open-source Android privacy app that helps you discover and control hidden tracking activity in installed applications. It uses Android's VPN functionality to analyze network traffic locally, without requiring root access or an external VPN server by default.

Monitor tracker connections in real time, identify companies collecting data, explore destination countries, and selectively block unwanted tracking. TrackerControl combines multiple tracker lists, including DuckDuckGo Tracker Radar and Disconnect, and supports custom blocklists. Choose between Minimal, Standard, and Strict blocking modes to balance privacy and app compatibility.

Additional features include tracker-library analysis, traffic logs, optional DNS-over-HTTPS, and remote VPN routing through Mullvad, IVPN, or custom WireGuard configurations. The GitHub edition includes the full tracker-blocking functionality.

TrackerControl is developed as an open-source research project and does not intercept encrypted HTTPS content. Android allows only one VPN service at a time, so it cannot operate alongside a separate VPN app. Blocking may affect some applications, and no tracker-detection solution guarantees complete protection.
